requirements: Must have completed at least one full academic session at FULafia.
Minimum CGPA of 2.50 at the time of application.
Must meet the O'Level (5 credits incl. English and Mathematics) and UTME subject requirements of the new programme.
No outstanding school fees for the current or previous sessions.
Written consent from the Head of Department of both the current and the proposed programme.
The proposed programme must have available capacity for the session.
notes: Transfers are only considered into a programme at the same or a lower level.
Approved transfers take effect from the next academic session; you continue in your current programme until then.
Courses already passed that are common to both programmes may be credited on approval of the new department.
A transfer can be applied for only once during your course of study.
transfer.feeNotice: A non-refundable programme transfer processing fee of ₦10,000.00 applies. Pay it under Fees → Standalone before submitting an application.
